dct_title_s: Satellite-detected flood waters, as of 29 November 2019, over Loukoléla, Cuvette Department, Republic of Congo
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: FL20191205COG** This map illustrates satellite-detected flood waters along the Congo River over, Loukoléla, Loukoléla District, Cuvette Department in Republic of Congo as observed from Pleiades-1 imagery acquired on 29 November 2019. 136 ha of potential flood waters and 168 potentially flooded structures have been identified in Loukoléla and its vicinity. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to UNITAR -UNOSAT.
